records.title: LAST: Looped Audio Spectrogram Transformer
records.reason: LAST reuses Transformer blocks to update only the audio class token after processing input tokens, reducing additional layer computation for audio recognition. The primary text evaluates AudioSet and reports accuracy/compute trade-offs, but this is an audio spectrogram classifier rather than an LLM/VLM inference method; relation to generative serving is weak.
